dev:
Solution scripts are LLM-generated and may print without bound, so the
orchestrator never holds the whole stream. The head keeps the early
progress and score lines, the tail keeps the traceback, and the elided
middle is replaced by a byte-count marker.
notice: Keeps the first and last bytes of a stream within a fixed budget.

pattern.name: bounded-buffer
pattern.rationale: Caps orchestrator memory for untrusted subprocess output.
pattern.violations: Unbounded buffering lets one candidate exhaust memory.

summary: Accumulate stream bytes while retaining only a head and a tail window.
